actual_export_smoke.observed: Both real-task MAPPING.md outputs carry the source-qualified boundary and additional field-specific losses; read back after actual CLI generation.
actual_export_smoke.scope: Export generation and Compose config only, not image build, task execution or destination grading.

limits: Model-call zero is a scripted declaration supported by absent SDK/guarded sockets and zero-token usage, not universal metering.
Extra trajectory/database data planes remained reachable.
Report grading was a deterministic lexical proxy, not the paid upstream report judge.

limits.observed_loss: Text precedes JSON and only scalar score/reward JSON keys are supported. Harbor is JSON-first and retains keyed rewards; pure Inspect lacks the native finiteness guard. Karotte rejects a nonfinite final score later. Inspect-Harbor matrix scoring is separate.

User overrides, verifier.env and verifier-phase network policy are not replayed; raw truthy-field detectors can miss UID 0 and legacy allow_internet policies. Baseline/agent policy, MCP and solution/environment overrides are already flagged but not enforced.

A separate verifier image and declared-artifact transfer are not reproduced. Inspect grades the live agent image. Karotte kills student processes, wipes the workdir, restores root-collected submission copies and grades those in the same container; a matching grade is not equivalent isolation.

Harbor healthchecks/readiness are not replayed. Karotte bakes discovered setup scripts into the image instead of running them at each startup. The real retained MiMo format-code-task-002552 declares healthcheck setup.

Native Harbor uploads non-build-spec environment/ files into the prebuilt-image workdir. Pure Inspect merely copies them beside the export; Karotte maps tests and special setup, not the general overlay.
Without an explicit or local Dockerfile WORKDIR the helper chooses /. Native Harbor omits -w when unspecified and preserves the prebuilt image default; the defaults need not agree.

Build and agent phase budgets are not preserved. Karotte base-build budgets clamp to 300-3600s, oracle tool calls to 300s, cheat tool calls to 1500s and verifier budget to 300-2100s, independent of the whole-run watchdog. The real event-summary verifier budget is 60s but resolves to 300s in Karotte.

Only CPU/RAM map; Karotte applies bounds after startup. Storage/GPU/TPU, gpu_types, OS, skills_dir and legacy memory/storage fields have no faithful mapping. A GPU live cell is refused by admission, not converted into a supported run.
The harness requires Debian apt/account utilities, adds its own Python and packages, replaces PATH and uses a fixed student identity. It is not a neutral layer compatible with every Harbor image.

Verifier collect hooks are not executed. Inspect does not publish Harbor artifacts; Karotte consumes absolute source paths only, dropping relative sources, service/exclude/host-destination details and grading collected copies.

Multi-step hooks, environments and reward aggregation are not mapped. Karotte normalizes/truncates IDs and does not replay version/authors/metadata. Its export fake model is nop, while the live runner separately materializes oracle mounts.

Inspect stages file bytes, not mode/link/empty-directory identity. Karotte oracle skips symlinks and mounts byte copies read-only. Both force bash /tests/test.sh rather than honoring the native executable script interpreter. The Inspect-Harbor matrix upload path separately refuses symlink/oversize helpers.
Multi-service Compose is refused rather than successfully converted; MCP sidecar lifecycle is not mapped.

The generated Compose service does not override CMD with a keepalive, unlike Harbor and Inspect-Harbor. [INFERENCE] An image whose CMD exits may prevent a live control from starting. No admitted run was available to resolve this.

Upstream _graded tries JSON then text and returns 0.0 on missing/malformed outputs. The current adapter accepts a recorded reward, so that fallback is indistinguishable from a genuine task zero; it is not proven fail-closed infrastructure grading.

The actual source/parser evidence supports refusal of users/services, unsupported environment fields, multi-step, Compose, advisory disk, unbuilt separate images and incompatible phase/CIDR networks. The scripted oracle does not apply solution.env. The adapter also needs the optional Harbor runtime.
